Tips for #WaltDisneyWorld attractions with young kids?? #DisneyParks
Do you know how to make the most of Walt Disney World attractions with young kids? You're about to! Take these tips to heart for an unforgettable first-time trip. 

🎢 Know your kids' heights to plan which attractions you can all ride.

⚡️ Buy Lightning Lane passes for a shorter wait.

🤝 Use Rider Switch to take turns enjoying bigger attractions even if smaller family members can't.

Which attraction is first on your list?️
